sources.title: The Century Dictionary
sources.publisher: The Century Company; Internet Archive/Open Library scan
sources.licenseOrPublicDomainBasis: Edition published 1889–1891; public-domain scan of a pre-1931 work.
attributionRequirements: Preserve source title, publisher, version, stable URL, and rights statement on every derived claim.
redistributionRestrictions: Use only public-domain page images/OCR; do not import later copyrighted editorial additions.
sources.permittedUseClass: historical definitions, technical senses, labels, quotations metadata, and etymologies
sourceLimitations: Large entries require human sense-boundary review
sources.editorialLineage: William Dwight Whitney and Century Company editorial program.
sources.sourceRootRole: Independent public-domain historical and technical comparison source.
sources.locatorStrategy: Open Library/Internet Archive ID, volume, printed page, column, headword, and OCR line range.

sources.title: ConceptNet
attributionRequirements: Credit ConceptNet and preserve CC BY-SA 4.0; retain edge source attribution.
redistributionRestrictions: Share-alike applies; constituent source licenses and quality must be reviewed.
sources.permittedUseClass: reviewable semantic-relationship candidates with source attribution
sourceLimitations: Commonsense edges are not dictionary sense analysis
sources.sourceRootRole: Relationship discovery and corroboration review aid.
sources.locatorStrategy: Release, edge URI, start/end concept URIs, relation, source assertion, and download line number.

sources.title: DBnary English Extract
sources.licenseOrPublicDomainBasis: Extracted Wiktionary content remains subject to Wiktionary CC BY-SA 4.0/GFDL terms.
attributionRequirements: Attribute English Wiktionary contributors and DBnary/GETALP; preserve share-alike obligations.
redistributionRestrictions: Do not treat DBnary as an editorially independent source from Wiktionary.
sources.permittedUseClass: structured Wiktionary-derived lexical entries and relations in a share-alike layer
sourceLimitations: Some relations are entry-level rather than sense-level
sources.editorialLineage: Automated extraction of Wiktionary; same editorial lineage.
sources.sourceRootRole: Deterministic structured extraction aid, never an independent corroborating vote.
sources.locatorStrategy: Dump date, RDF graph, subject URI, predicate, object, and originating Wiktionary page/revision when available.

sources.title: English Wiktionary
sources.licenseOrPublicDomainBasis: Entry text is dual-licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 and GFDL, subject to per-item exceptions.
attributionRequirements: Provide contributor/page attribution and a link to the transparent source; preserve applicable share-alike terms.
redistributionRestrictions: Share-alike applies to adapted entry text; external quotations, audio, and images require separate review.
sources.permittedUseClass: definitions, forms, labels, pronunciations, etymologies, and examples after license-aware filtering
sourceLimitations: License compatibility requires isolation and review
sources.sourceRootRole: Supplemental form, label, pronunciation, and etymology evidence in a license-isolated layer.
sources.locatorStrategy: Dump date, namespace/page title, page ID, revision ID, section language, entry heading, and source line span.

sources.title: A Dictionary of the English Language
sources.editionOrDatasetVersion: 1755 first edition, with 1785 scan fallback for verification
attributionRequirements: Preserve source title, publisher, version, stable URL, and rights statement on every derived claim.
redistributionRestrictions: Exclude copyrighted modern commentary and editions.
sources.permittedUseClass: historical senses, definitions, etymologies, and citation metadata
sourceLimitations: Typography and OCR require human verification
sources.locatorStrategy: Edition, volume, printed page, column, headword, sense number, and page-image URL.

sources.title: MOBY Thesaurus II
sources.licenseOrPublicDomainBasis: Moby Project resources were dedicated to the public domain; Gutenberg distributes the machine-readable work.
attributionRequirements: Preserve source title, publisher, version, stable URL, and rights statement on every derived claim.
redistributionRestrictions: Do not accept large related-term clusters as synonyms without source and sense review.
sources.locatorStrategy: eBook number, root term, source line number, and raw-file checksum.

sources.title: NASA Thesaurus
sources.publisher: NASA Scientific and Technical Information Program
sources.licenseOrPublicDomainBasis: U.S. Government work; official page provides complete downloadable data and requested citation.
attributionRequirements: Use NASA STI's supplied citation and do not imply endorsement.
redistributionRestrictions: Review any third-party material or marks separately.
sources.permittedUseClass: aerospace and science terms, definitions, preferred terms, and hierarchical relationships
sourceLimitations: Edition date is old; scope notes need format-aware extraction
sources.sourceRootRole: Aerospace and physical-science technical sense authority.
sources.locatorStrategy: Edition, SKOS concept URI, preferred label, source file checksum, and scope-note field.

sources.title: NIST CSRC Glossary
sources.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
sources.editionOrDatasetVersion: daily JSON snapshot, pinned by acquisition date
sources.licenseOrPublicDomainBasis: NIST U.S. Government content is generally public domain; every definition remains attributed to its named source publication.
attributionRequirements: Cite the source publication rather than treating the changing glossary page as the authority.
redistributionRestrictions: CNSSI or other non-NIST source text requires item-level rights review.
sources.permittedUseClass: cybersecurity and privacy definitions with source-publication attribution
sourceLimitations: Not all included sources are NIST works
Definitions are context-specific and change over time
sources.editorialLineage: NIST aggregation of standards and guidance terminology.
sources.sourceRootRole: Cybersecurity and privacy technical claims with publication-level provenance.
sources.locatorStrategy: Snapshot date, term key, source document identifier/version, section/page, and JSON object hash.

sources.title: Medical Subject Headings (MeSH)
sources.editionOrDatasetVersion: current annual production year, pinned at acquisition
sources.licenseOrPublicDomainBasis: NLM freely provides MeSH with explicit attribution, currency, disclaimer, and no-endorsement conditions.
attributionRequirements: Acknowledge NLM clearly and conspicuously; identify the MeSH version.
redistributionRestrictions: Keep data current or clearly identify it as non-current; translation files have separate terms.
sources.permittedUseClass: biomedical preferred terms, concepts, scope notes, and hierarchy
sourceLimitations: Indexing vocabulary rather than a general dictionary
sources.sourceRootRole: Biomedical technical term and preferred-form authority.
sources.locatorStrategy: MeSH year, Descriptor/Concept/Term UI, XML element path, and source file checksum.

sources.title: Open English WordNet 2025
sources.publisher: Open English WordNet Community, University of Galway
attributionRequirements: Credit the Open English WordNet Community and preserve CC BY 4.0 notice and version.
redistributionRestrictions: Attribution and change indication are required.
sources.permittedUseClass: definitions, senses, lemmas, examples, and semantic relations with attribution
sources.sourceRootRole: Primary modern sense spine and relation network.
sources.locatorStrategy: Release ID plus part-of-speech and eight-digit synset offset; retain original gloss and file checksum.

sources.title: Princeton WordNet
sources.licenseOrPublicDomainBasis: WordNet license permits use, copy, modification, and distribution without fee when notices are preserved.
attributionRequirements: Preserve the Princeton copyright, license, disclaimer, and scholarly citation.
redistributionRestrictions: All copies and modifications must retain the required notices; Princeton name cannot imply endorsement.
sources.permittedUseClass: sense and relationship comparison with required notices
sources.editorialLineage: Princeton Cognitive Science Laboratory; ancestor of OEWN.
sources.sourceRootRole: Lineage audit and edition-difference source, not an independent consensus vote.
sources.locatorStrategy: Release 3.1, part-of-speech, synset offset, and source file checksum.

sources.title: Roget's Thesaurus of English Words and Phrases
sources.licenseOrPublicDomainBasis: Project Gutenberg marks the work public domain in the USA.
attributionRequirements: Preserve source title, publisher, version, stable URL, and rights statement on every derived claim.
redistributionRestrictions: Relationships require human validation; thesaurus co-membership is not automatic synonymy.
sources.permittedUseClass: review candidates for semantic groupings and historical related-term evidence
sourceLimitations: Groups are broader than synonym sets
sources.sourceRootRole: Relationship discovery and review source, not automatic accepted synonym authority.
sources.locatorStrategy: eBook number, class, section, head number, paragraph, and source line range.

sources.title: NAL Agricultural Thesaurus and Glossary
sources.licenseOrPublicDomainBasis: U.S. Government waives rights under CC0 1.0 for NALT.
attributionRequirements: Record USDA NAL source and snapshot even though CC0 does not require attribution.
sources.permittedUseClass: agricultural terms, definitions, translations, and concept relations
sources.editorialLineage: USDA National Agricultural Library controlled vocabulary.
sources.sourceRootRole: Agricultural and biological technical sense authority.
sources.locatorStrategy: Snapshot date, concept URI, language tag, RDF predicate, and source file checksum.

sources.title: USGS Thesaurus
sources.licenseOrPublicDomainBasis: USGS explains that employee-created U.S. Government works are public domain in the United States.
attributionRequirements: Credit USGS and retain source snapshot/version.
sources.permittedUseClass: earth-science terms, scope notes, and broader/narrower relationships
sourceLimitations: Controlled vocabulary, not complete lexical senses
sources.locatorStrategy: Snapshot date, vocabulary table, term ID, scope field, and database checksum.

sources.title: Webster's Revised Unabridged Dictionary
sources.publisher: C. & G. Merriam; Project Gutenberg transcription
sources.licenseOrPublicDomainBasis: Project Gutenberg marks eBook 29765 public domain in the USA.
attributionRequirements: Preserve source title, publisher, version, stable URL, and rights statement on every derived claim.
redistributionRestrictions: Remove Project Gutenberg trademarks or comply with its distribution terms; confirm law outside the USA.
sources.permittedUseClass: historical definitions, forms, labels, and etymologies after transcription review
sourceLimitations: Historical biases and outdated labels require contextual review
sources.locatorStrategy: eBook number, source section/file, headword, entry ordinal, and normalized line range; retain raw transcription checksum.

sources.title: An Etymological Dictionary of Modern English
sources.publisher: Ernest Weekley; John Murray; Internet Archive/Open Library scan
sources.licenseOrPublicDomainBasis: Published in 1921; public domain in the United States.
attributionRequirements: Preserve source title, publisher, version, stable URL, and rights statement on every derived claim.
redistributionRestrictions: Do not modernize uncertain derivations into certainty.
sources.permittedUseClass: historical etymology proposals and qualified origin claims
sourceLimitations: Many derivations require comparison with newer open evidence
sources.editorialLineage: Ernest Weekley's early twentieth-century etymological scholarship.
sources.sourceRootRole: Historical etymology claim source, always date-qualified.
sources.locatorStrategy: Archive ID, volume, printed column/page, headword, and OCR line range.

sources.title: Wikidata Lexemes
sources.licenseOrPublicDomainBasis: Lexeme namespace structured data is CC0 1.0.
attributionRequirements: Attribution is not legally required under CC0; record provenance as a SourceRoot quality requirement.
sources.permittedUseClass: structured forms, grammatical features, senses, and external identifiers
sources.sourceRootRole: Form identity and cross-resource alignment authority.
sources.locatorStrategy: Dump date plus Lexeme, Form, Sense, and statement GUID; retain referenced source IDs.
